name: Create Meeting
description: Creates a new meeting with optional associations to other objects. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/crm/engagements/meetings#post-%2Fcrm%2Fv3%2Fobjects%2Fmeetings)

configurable_props.name: toObjectType
configurable_props.label: Associated Object Type
configurable_props.description: Type of object the meeting is being associated with

configurable_props.name: toObjectId
configurable_props.label: Associated Object
configurable_props.description: ID of object the meeting is being associated with

configurable_props.name: associationType
configurable_props.label: Association Type
configurable_props.description: A unique identifier to indicate the association type between the meeting and the other object

configurable_props.name: objectProperties
configurable_props.label: Meeting Properties
configurable_props.description: Enter the meeting properties as a JSON object. Required properties: hs_meeting_title, hs_meeting_body, hs_meeting_start_time, hs_meeting_end_time. Optional: hs_meeting_status
